summary: This paper investigates automatic paraphrase identification using a fine-tuned Sentence-BERT model. Researchers developed a news corpus focused on COVID-19 by scraping CNN and Yahoo News. The study demonstrates that SBERT significantly outperforms standard BERT in processing speed and efficiency, achieving a 77% precision rate in classifying semantically similar sentences within the specialized dataset.
keywords: Sentence-BERT, Paraphrase Identification, News Corpus, Semantic Similarity, NLP
topics: Natural Language Processing, Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics
